name: Machir
title: Manasseh's Firstborn Son
summary: Machir was the firstborn son of Manasseh, Joseph's son. He was the ancestor of a powerful clan that conquered the Gilead region east of the Jordan. Machir's descendants were known as skilled warriors who played an important role in the conquest of the land.

keyEvents.title: The Birth and Lineage of Machir
keyEvents.description: Machir was the son of Manasseh and became the ancestor of the Machir clan. He is regarded as Manasseh's firstborn son.

keyEvents.title: The Conquest of Gilead
keyEvents.description: Makir and his descendants went to Gilead, captured the land, and drove out the Amorites who lived there. Moses gave Gilead to Makir.

keyEvents.title: Makir's Inheritance in Transjordan
keyEvents.description: Makir was allotted Gilead and Bashan as his inheritance, a fertile region east of the Jordan River.

keyEvents.title: Makir's Descendants in the Tribe of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Makir's lineage is thoroughly recorded in Chronicles as an important branch of the tribe of Manasseh.

keyEvents.title: Makir's Clan in the Song of Deborah
keyEvents.description: In the Song of Deborah, Makir is mentioned among the tribes that came to fight against Sisera, showing the clan's military significance during the time of the judges.

keyEvents.title: The Daughters of Zelophehad and Inheritance Rights
keyEvents.description: Zelophehad, a descendant of Makir through Gilead, had no sons. His daughters claimed their right to inherit, and God granted them justice, establishing an important legal precedent in Israel.
